apps.idea: A note-taking app with user login, notebooks, tags, and full-text search

vision_issues.description: The 'Logout' button is present in the header of the login page, which is confusing as a user would not be logged in to be on this page.
The 'Logout' button is present in the header of the register page, which is confusing as a user would not be logged in to be on this page.

apps.idea: A job board with user accounts, job postings, applications, and employer profiles

vision_issues.description: The 'Sign In' heading is not properly aligned with the form fields. It appears left-aligned while the form is centered, creating an unbalanced look.

The input fields for 'Email' and 'Password' are plain and lack any styling beyond basic browser defaults. They could benefit from borders, padding, and consistent height/width to improve user experience.
The login button is a basic primary color. It could benefit from a hover state, focus state, and more distinct styling to visually indicate interactivity.
There is no 'Forgot Password?' or 'Sign Up' link on the login page, which are common and important features for user authentication processes.
The entire login form block could benefit from being contained within a card or a designated area with a background to visually separate it from the rest of the page and draw attention to it.
Overall spacing between elements in the login form could be refined for better readability and visual appeal.
The /register page is almost entirely blank, only showing the header/footer and copyright information. There are no registration fields or content visible.
This page is unusable as a registration page because it does not provide any means for a user to register.

apps.idea: A personal finance tracker with accounts, transactions, budgets, and spending reports

vision_issues.description: The 'FinanceApp' logo/title in the header is not vertically aligned with the navigation links. The navigation links in the header are right-aligned, which is good, but they lack sufficient padding or margin on the right side, making them too close to the edge of the viewport. Consider adding `padding-right` or `margin-right` to the last item or the navigation container. The overall layout of the login form is functional, but the input fields could benefit from a slight increase in `height` for better usability, and the 'Login' button's `border-radius` could be made more consistent with a slightly rounded square shape for a more modern look, aligning with many current UI trends.
The /register page is a blank white screen, indicating a critical rendering issue (e.g., component not loaded, styling problem, or JavaScript error).
